tree_notes.content_text: Research collection: compare memory savings and quality tradeoffs for language models running on phones.
The study shares key and value projections. It reduces KV-cache memory by 50% with a 3.1% increase in perplexity. Sharing projections complements head sharing.
This study quantizes the cache instead of sharing projections. It reduces KV-cache memory by 25% with a 1% increase in perplexity.
